title: Tower Rush
description: Race to the top of a brand-new tower every round, stacked from random sections: sweeping kill bars, rising lava, pushers, lasers, blinking steps and more. No checkpoints, one shared timer, and online everyone climbs the same tower.
controls: WASD / arrows to move, Space to jump, drag or Left/Right to turn the camera, Shift for shift lock, R to reset
